purpose: Extend arbitrary atlas research to generated multi-page atlas fixtures with page manifests and frame-to-page bindings.

external_anchors.used_for: Multiple atlas pages, texture bind/page grouping, rotation, whitespace stripping, padding, and atlas metadata context.
PNG remains the page image carrier.

page_policy.basis: first-fit page selection with scanline shelf placement and 0/90-degree rotation candidates

limitations: Stage 0 multi-page atlas proof supports generated page fixtures only.
Runtime playback is a sidecar timing model, not a production renderer.
Live external editor-authored atlas fixtures remain separate evidence.

page_policy.basis: first-fit page selection with scanline shelf placement and 0/90-degree rotation candidates

runtime_playback.sampling_rule: time_ms modulo total_duration_ms selects frame interval and then that frame's page binding

limitations: Only generated multi-page atlas fixtures are covered.
Only rectangular regions and 0/90-degree rotations are covered.
Production renderer texture binding is not claimed.
